0022600128.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-3) visit the Boston Celtics (2-1) for the Nets' fourth game of the season, with Brooklyn 5th in the Atlantic and 14th in the East on a three-game losing streak, while Boston is 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and riding a two-game winning streak. The Nets are 0-2 at home and 0-1 on the road, and the Celtics are 2-0 at home, with Tyler Bilodeau out for Brooklyn with a shoulder sprain, Mikel Brown Jr. day-to-day and a game-time decision listed for rest (7.0 points and 19.9 minutes per game this season), and Devin Carter out for Boston with an illness. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 1-3, including a 148-111 defeat in Boston on February 27, 2026.
